sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:41

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:41:1
items.html: The difference among these three HaVaYaHs of Yodin is in the matter of their vowels: For the filling indicates the measure of the level of the degree, which depends on the aspect of the coarseness in the screen; and since all three discernments of Galgalta are the level of Hochma, which is AB and the aspect of the upper AVI, as above, it is necessarily so that all three HaVaYaHs are in the filling of Yodin without change. However, the vocalization indicates the source of the degree: whether it is its own aspect, or from its inclusion within the one above it, or from its inclusion from those below it — also the measure of that inclusion. And since its two lower discernments are not from the aspect of Galgalta itself, but from what it includes from those below it, therefore the difference is discerned in the manner of their vocalization.
